language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

Hello, I am Tim.

Hi, my name is Carla. This is my parents’ charter fishing boat where we take people out fishing for crab, salmon and tuna. I love being on the ocean, but my favorite time is between trips when I can explore all the different kinds of plants that grow along the California coast. I’ve even started my own plant nursery!
What do you know about a plant life cycle? Let's go to my plant nursery.
I’ve learned a lot about growing new plants for my garden and around the house.
Different kind of plants propagate, or reproduce, in different ways.
Let’s look at a few statements about plant reproduction and figure out which are true and which are false.

helperSimple.text: Please help Carla review some facts about plant reproduction by marking each statement as True or False.

activities.title: Is this statement true or false?
activities.subtitle: A plant species that doesn't reproduce fast enough will become extinct.

activities.title: Is this statement true or false?
activities.subtitle: Plants reproduce in order to replace ones that die and keep the species going.

activities.title: Is this statement true or false?
activities.subtitle: All plants reproduce in the same way.

activities.title: Is this statement true or false?
activities.subtitle: All living things go through a life cycle that includes reproduction.

activities.title: Is this statement true or false?
activities.subtitle: A plant species is considered "endangered" when there are only a few individual plants left.

activities.title: Is this statement true or false?
activities.subtitle: Only some plants reproduce.

outro.text: Nicely done! Now let’s go into my greenhouse. I’ve got lots of plants there. Did you know that plants, just like animals, can become extinct if not enough of them reproduce?
